turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I have a fever, plus a cough, greenish or yellowish nasal discharge, and pain around my eyes (both right and left) with burning/sharp quality. The pain is about 6/10 and radiates to the back of my head and both temples.
[ASK] Do you have prominent sore throat/upper-airway symptoms (throat pain or hoarseness) without significant wheezing?
[ASK] Do you have nasal congestion/discharge with facial pressure or pain (sinus symptoms)?
Yes. I have greenish or yellowish nasal discharge, and pain around my eyes with burning/sharp quality, plus it radiates to the back of my head and both temples.
[ASK] Do you have symptoms lasting **less than 12 weeks** (e.g., recent onset, improving or fluctuating within weeks rather than months)?
Yes — my symptoms have been lasting less than 12 weeks.
